title: Teddy flips; Gabby joins on piano
summary: After Teddy Wilson flipped, Roy hired Gabby and headed to Buckeye Lake.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: So you still have the band, and...

So we got our money, and then we left and we went down to Ohio. We played Buckeye Lake, down near where what'cha-call-him comes from, Sol(?)... And we had a piano player with us then. Because Teddy flipped, you know. Teddy flipped the night that Joe Louis won the championship. We played at the (?) in Chicago that night. And I had to get another piano player. That's Gabby(?). I don't know what Gabby's(?) last name was. Does that ring a bell to you?
He think he was Horace Henderson, you know. Tried to play like Horace, he was set like Horace...

Well, Gabby(?) was one of those type of cats, if you'd stop somewhere to get gas or something, he would go in there for like soda, you know, he could open the bottle and drink it down before you could bat your eyes. We played Columbus... No, we went from Columbus... Because we were on our way to play the Savoy, to play this... Buckeye Lake was

where we played, and Zanesville was the name of the town where what'cha-call-him comes from. I stopped, because somehow it was tired...that band grew tired. Also, it looked like a set-up. Plus, I had a big deal(?), like one of them gangsters get you, but it wasn't, because I could get police calls in those days with my radio (?), know where the fires were from the police calls and things.
Joe was in the band, I think...
